item.title: Ginger-laden truck worth lakhs overturns in Balasore, driver injured
item.description: Balasore: A truck carrying ginger worth lakhs of rupees overturned and fell nearly 15 feet below a national highway near Mathani Chowk under Basta police limits in Balasore district early Monday morning, leaving the driver injured. The accident occurred around 5 am while the truck was en route from Assam to Visakhapatnam.
